profiles.biography: Master Sergeant Jeff Prosperie is a percussion adjudicator, a World Snare Drum Champion, and the only individual to capture the 'Triple Crown' of solo competition (DCI, PAS, DCA). A member of the legendary West Point Band 'Hellcats' since 2006, where he has served as Section Leader and Principal Drummer, he was inducted into the World Drum Corps Hall of Fame in 2018 and serves on the Percussive Arts Society Board of Advisors. A frequent DCI and WGI World Championship finalist judge, he has been a DCI percussion judge for about 20 years. Before his Army service he was percussion designer/caption head for the World Champion Phantom Regiment, percussion instructor for the national-champion University of North Texas drumline, Director of Percussion Studies at the University of Louisiana-Lafayette, and principal percussion with the Baton Rouge Symphony.

seasonHighlights.title: World Drum Corps Hall of Fame inductee; DCI/PAS/DCA solo Triple Crown

facts.fact: World Snare Drum Champion; DCI/PAS/DCA Triple Crown; West Point Hellcats; WDCHOF 2018; DCI percussion judge ~20 yrs; ex-Phantom Regiment caption head

profiles.biography: Chad Armbruster is a brass/music adjudicator with about 25 years in the pageantry arts as a performer, instructor, director, and judge for marching bands, indoor drumlines, color guards, and drum and bugle corps. He holds a Bachelor's in Music Education from the University of Minnesota and a Master of Arts in Education from Hamline University. He was a 2005 brass co-caption head of the Blue Stars and has held teaching and leadership positions with Minnesota Brass, Southwind, Madison Scouts, Spirit of Atlanta, and several Minnesota high schools. He adjudicates for Drum Corps International (including the Music-Brass caption), the Tri-State Judges Association, the Northstar Colorguard Circuit, and the Minnesota Percussion Association.

facts.fact: 25 yrs pageantry; Univ. of Minnesota + Hamline degrees; Blue Stars 2005 brass co-caption head; DCI Music-Brass judge

profiles.biography: Jeff Ausdemore is a percussion adjudicator, arranger, and educator who judges for Drum Corps International, Winter Guard International, and Bands of America, and is a percussion committee member for the Percussive Arts Society, TMEA, and TBA. He was percussion arranger and caption head for the Blue Knights drum and bugle corps from 2006 to 2010, during which the percussion program earned individual and ensemble championships and consistent DCI top-12 finishes. He holds a Master of Music (with distinction) from New Mexico State University and a Bachelor of Music (high honors) from Belmont University, is an adjunct instructor of percussion at East Texas A&M University, and is President and co-founder of the online music-education platform Stryvemind.

facts.fact: DCI/WGI/BOA percussion judge; Blue Knights percussion caption head 2006-10; NMSU + Belmont degrees; ETAMU adjunct; Stryvemind co-founder

profiles.biography: Ronnie Rios is a multi-Grammy-nominated music educator and brass/music adjudicator from Alice, Texas, who serves as Director of Athletic Bands at the University of Texas Rio Grande Valley. He holds Bachelor's and Master's degrees in Music Education (Summa Cum Laude) and was Director of Bands at Harlingen High School for 21 years, where all six concert bands earned consistent UIL Sweepstakes awards and the marching band made 11 consecutive Texas State Marching Band Championships appearances. He is an active adjudicator for UIL, Drum Corps International, and Bands of America, including the Brass Performance caption at DCI World Championships.

facts.fact: Grammy-nominated educator; UTRGV Director of Athletic Bands; former Harlingen HS Dir of Bands 21 yrs; DCI/BOA/UIL brass judge

profiles.biography: Dr. Albert Lo is a brass/music adjudicator and conductor, a native of Chicago, who is Director of Instrumental Music Ensembles at the Austin Community College District and resident Conductor/Artistic Director for the Valley Wind Symphony. He completed a Doctor of Musical Arts at the University of North Texas, a Master of Arts at Western Illinois University, and a Bachelor of Music at Northern Illinois University. He adjudicates for Drum Corps International, Music for All, Texas UIL, and other associations in the United States and Asia, serving in the Brass and General Effect Music captions at DCI World Championships.

facts.fact: DMA (UNT); ACC Director of Instrumental Music Ensembles; Valley Wind Symphony; DCI/BOA brass & GE judge

profiles.biography: Michael Gray is a visual and general-effect adjudicator whose career in the visual and pageantry arts spans more than three decades as a designer, instructor, clinician, and judge at the highest levels of DCI, WGI, and Bands of America. He has served as program coordinator for the Bluecoats drum corps and Ensemble Caption Facilitator for Winter Guard International, judging General Effect and Visual captions at DCI World Championships. He is also an accomplished visual artist whose classes on impressionism and plein air painting are popular nationwide.

profiles.biography: Dennis Argul is a brass/music adjudicator, composer, and arranger and a retired music educator with a 35-year career in New Jersey public schools, currently Senior Director of Music and Education for JAZZ HOUSE KiDS in Montclair, NJ. Active in the marching arts since 1974, he marched the St. Andrew's Kidets and the Bayonne Bridgemen (1976-1981) and has worked with the Cadets, Connecticut Hurricanes, Govenaires, Carolina Gold, Sunrisers, and Caballeros, and is the brass arranger for the Bushwackers (a Bushwackers Hall of Fame member). For three decades he has adjudicated for many organizations, most recently the Music-Brass caption at DCI World Championships.

facts.fact: 35-yr NJ educator; JAZZ HOUSE KiDS; Bayonne Bridgemen alum; Bushwackers brass arranger & HOF; DCI Music-Brass judge

profiles.biography: Kyle Weirich is a music adjudicator and a music educator in his 29th year of teaching, currently Music Coordinator for Elkhart Community Schools and Director of Orchestras at Elkhart Central High School in Indiana, where the symphony orchestra has been a regular ISSMA state finalist and performed at the Midwest Clinic. He earned music education degrees from Western Michigan University and VanderCook College of Music and performed three seasons with the Star of Indiana drum and bugle corps. He adjudicates for Bands of America, Drum Corps International, and other circuits, serving in the Music Analysis caption.

facts.fact: 29-yr educator; Elkhart Community Schools Music Coordinator; Star of Indiana alum; WMU + VanderCook; DCI/BOA music judge

profiles.biography: Lee Carlson is a visual and general-effect adjudicator and longtime drum corps leader who has served as Artistic Director and Director of Competition for Drum Corps International. A judge for DCI, Bands of America, Winter Guard International, and many circuits for 21 years, he also served four years as a DCI Visual Caption Head and five years as DCI Judges Training Coordinator. For some 40 years he has been the drill designer and color guard instructor for the University of Southern California Trojan Marching Band, and he has instructed the Blue Knights, Argonne Rebels, and Sky Ryders and taught 18 years at Indio High School. He has adjudicated the Drum Corps Japan Championships nine times and wrote for mass bands at the 1984 Los Angeles Olympics, the 1986 Statue of Liberty Centennial, and the 1989 French Revolution Bicentennial in Paris.

profiles.biography: Michele Bowers is a color guard and visual adjudicator who has judged for Winter Guard International (movement and percussion visual) since 2005 and for Drum Corps International. She is the color guard director at Walnut Hills High School in Cincinnati, Ohio, and visual coordinator for its Marching Blue and Gold, and is a visual designer for the Talawanda High School indoor drumline. An alumna of the Pride of Cincinnati drum and bugle corps (1981-1982) and Phantom Regiment winter guard and drum corps (1983), she holds a Bachelor's in Communication Arts from the University of Cincinnati.
